FFmpeg version: 8.1.1
FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.1.tar.xz
FFmpeg SHA-256: b6863adde98898f42602017462871b5f6333e65aec803fdd7a6308639c52edf3
Minimum iOS: 17.0

Configure flags:
  --disable-everything
  --disable-programs
  --disable-doc
  --disable-debug
  --disable-network
  --disable-autodetect
  --disable-asm
  --disable-avdevice
  --disable-avfilter
  --disable-shared
  --enable-pic
  --enable-static
  --enable-avcodec
  --enable-avformat
  --enable-avutil
  --enable-swresample
  --enable-swscale
  --enable-protocol=file
  --enable-demuxer=vc1,avi,mov,dv,asf,rm
  --enable-parser=vc1,mpeg4video
  --enable-decoder=vc1,vc1image,y41p,rawvideo,prores_raw,dvvideo,mjpeg,mpeg4,msmpeg4v3,msrle,smc,r10k,r210,rv10,rv20,snow,utvideo,wmv2,pcm_s16le,mp3,aac,ac3,wmav2

Enabled demuxers: vc1, avi, mov, dv, asf, rm
Enabled decoders: vc1, vc1image, y41p, rawvideo, prores_raw, dvvideo, h263, mjpeg, mpeg4, msmpeg4v3, msrle, smc, r10k, r210, rv10, rv20, snow, utvideo, wmv2, pcm_s16le, mp3, aac, ac3, wmav2
Enabled parsers: ac3, vc1, mpeg4video
Enabled protocol: file
Enabled libraries linked into bridge: avformat, avcodec, avutil, swresample, swscale
Bridge frame outputs: direct NV12 video for even dimensions, BGRA fallback video for odd dimensions, and swresample-converted packed signed 16-bit PCM audio

Policy:
- No --enable-gpl
- No --enable-nonfree
- No external libraries
- No FFmpeg executable or runtime-downloaded plugin
- Decode-only bridge for the enabled legacy input codecs and audio formats; H.265 / HEVC MP4/MOV plus Apple-native audio output remain handled by Taption Encoder's AVAssetWriter path.

Notice/source/EULA checklist:
- The official source URL and SHA-256 above record provenance only; they do
  not by themselves satisfy LGPL distribution requirements for a statically
  linked application.
- Local bridge source is stored under Vendor/FFmpegLGPLDecodeBridge/Sources.
- The shipped notice and written source-material offer are stored at
  TaptionEncoder/OpenSourceNotices/FFmpeg-LGPL-Decode-Bridge.txt.
- The complete LGPL 2.1 text is stored at
  TaptionEncoder/OpenSourceNotices/LGPL-2.1.txt.
- Public distribution remains blocked until the exact corresponding source,
  local changes, build scripts, and application relinking materials are
  assembled and verified as deliverable for the distributed binary.
- Formal counsel approval and confirmation that the final App Store EULA and
  distribution mechanism preserve required reverse-engineering and relinking
  rights remain separate release gates.
